title: RunAsPPL Requires Context Validation
incorrectConclusion: LSA Protection misconfigured, requires immediate remediation
correctConclusion: RunAsPPL = 2 is valid state when Device Guard (HVCI) is enforced
recommendedLogic: IF RunAsPPL = 2 THEN check DeviceGuard status BEFORE recommending remediation
falsePositiveRate: 20-30% of RunAsPPL findings when HVCI is active
keyPrinciple: Artifact detection != Threat determination. Finding != Incident. Recommendation requires context.
airlift: NEVER recommend RunAsPPL remediation without verifying Device Guard + HVCI state first
